image.alt: A lone Buddhist monk in simple robes walking beside a merchant caravan on a dusty overland trade route, carrying only an alms bowl and a walking staff, no temple in sight.

monasteries.alt: A Buddhist cave monastery complex carved into a cliff face beside a Silk Route caravan halt, with merchant camels and traders resting near the entrance.

both-ways.alt: The weathered brick ruins of the ancient Nalanda monastic university in India, rows of monastic cell walls and a stepped stupa among excavated courtyards.
